name: vnc_screenshot
description: Capture the remote desktop as a JPEG. The response includes 'Resolution: WxH' (framebuffer size); your view of the image may be scaled, so compute coordinates in framebuffer pixels from that resolution. For click targeting prefer window positions from vnc_window_list/vnc_active_window and text from vnc_ocr_region over estimating from the image.

endpoint.description: Endpoint ID; default endpoint if omitted

delay.description: ms to wait before capture so the screen can settle; default 0

name: vnc_capture_burst
description: Capture a rapid frame sequence in one call to catch transient UI (toasts, hover highlights, animations, progress). Returns one image per frame plus per-frame timestamps in ms from burst start. Mostly-static screens are cheap per frame; use a small region and lower quality/scale for long bursts.

endpoint.description: Endpoint ID; default endpoint if omitted

quality.description: JPEG quality; default 60, auto-reduced if the payload cap is exceeded

scale.description: downscale factor applied after cropping; default 0.5

region_x.description: crop left edge in framebuffer px; all four region_* are required to crop

name: vnc_probe
description: Draw a marker at (x, y) on a screenshot without touching the remote desktop (no mouse move, focus change, or click). Use it to verify coordinates before clicking. Returns the annotated image: the magenta center dot is the exact target point, plus a coordinate label, guide lines 30px out, and edge axis labels.

endpoint.description: Endpoint ID; default endpoint if omitted

coordinate_source_resolution.description: Resolution (WxH, e.g. "1918x968") copied from the vnc_screenshot/vnc_grid response the coordinates came from

coordinate_space.description: framebuffer (default): raw pixels matching the Resolution metadata. calibrated: positions as seen in the returned image, mapped via your saved vnc_calibrate record; errors without acting if no valid record exists.

used_full_resolution.description: true if estimated from the full-resolution image; false if it was scaled/cropped or you are unsure (then verify with vnc_grid)

used_grid.description: true if vnc_grid was used to find or refine the coordinates

name: vnc_grid
description: Overlay a labeled grid (columns A-P, rows 1-12) on a screenshot without touching the remote desktop. Returns the image plus each cell label's center in framebuffer pixels; click at a cell center. Faster than repeated probes.

endpoint.description: Endpoint ID; default endpoint if omitted

name: vnc_click
description: Click at (x, y). Returns a confirmation and a screenshot with a marker ring at the click point. First verify the target window is in the foreground (vnc_active_window) and confirm coordinates (vnc_probe, vnc_grid, or vnc_ocr_region). Prefer keyboard shortcuts when possible.

coordinate_space.description: framebuffer (default): raw pixels matching the Resolution metadata. calibrated: positions as seen in the returned image, mapped via your saved vnc_calibrate record; errors without acting if no valid record exists.

endpoint.description: Endpoint ID; default endpoint if omitted

probe_validated.description: true only if a vnc_probe marker at these exact coordinates was on the intended target

coordinates_confirmed.description: true only after verifying via probe, grid, window position, or OCR

name: vnc_type_text
description: Type text as Unicode keysym events. Use vnc_paste_text for text that may not type reliably.

endpoint.description: Endpoint ID; default endpoint if omitted

name: vnc_key_press
description: Press a key or combo using X11 keysym names, e.g. 'Return', 'ctrl+c', 'alt+F4', 'shift+a'.

endpoint.description: Endpoint ID; default endpoint if omitted

name: vnc_move_mouse
description: Move the mouse cursor without clicking.

coordinate_space.description: framebuffer (default): raw pixels matching the Resolution metadata. calibrated: positions as seen in the returned image, mapped via your saved vnc_calibrate record; errors without acting if no valid record exists.

endpoint.description: Endpoint ID; default endpoint if omitted

name: vnc_drag
description: Drag with the left button held from (x1, y1) to (x2, y2).

coordinate_space.description: framebuffer (default): raw pixels matching the Resolution metadata. calibrated: positions as seen in the returned image, mapped via your saved vnc_calibrate record; errors without acting if no valid record exists.

endpoint.description: Endpoint ID; default endpoint if omitted

name: vnc_scroll
description: Scroll the mouse wheel at (x, y). Works without the helper agent.

coordinate_space.description: framebuffer (default): raw pixels matching the Resolution metadata. calibrated: positions as seen in the returned image, mapped via your saved vnc_calibrate record; errors without acting if no valid record exists.

amount.description: wheel notches; positive scrolls up, negative down; typically -10 to 10

endpoint.description: Endpoint ID; default endpoint if omitted

name: vnc_clipboard_set
description: Set the remote clipboard via VNC ClientCutText (Latin-1 only).

endpoint.description: Endpoint ID; default endpoint if omitted

name: vnc_paste_text
description: Set the remote clipboard, then send Ctrl+V. Reliable entry for special characters, URLs, or text vnc_type_text might mangle.

endpoint.description: Endpoint ID; default endpoint if omitted

name: vnc_list_endpoints
description: List registered VNC endpoints (IDs, descriptions, connection status, which is the default).

name: vnc_cursor_position
description: Get the remote mouse cursor position. Requires the vnc-helper agent.

endpoint.description: Endpoint ID; default endpoint if omitted

name: vnc_window_list
description: List visible windows with title, position, size, and PID. Requires the vnc-helper agent.

endpoint.description: Endpoint ID; default endpoint if omitted

name: vnc_active_window
description: Get the focused window's title, class, position, size, and PID. Requires the vnc-helper agent.

endpoint.description: Endpoint ID; default endpoint if omitted

name: vnc_set_active_window
description: Restore (if minimized), raise, and focus a window matched by title, class, or PID. Returns the window's title, class, position, size, and PID. Requires the vnc-helper agent.

endpoint.description: Endpoint ID; default endpoint if omitted

name: vnc_manage_window
description: Minimize, maximize, restore, or close a window matched by title, class, or PID. Requires the vnc-helper agent.

endpoint.description: Endpoint ID; default endpoint if omitted

name: vnc_run_command
description: Run a command via cmd.exe /c on the remote Windows machine; returns stdout, stderr, and exit code. Requires the vnc-helper agent.

endpoint.description: Endpoint ID; default endpoint if omitted

name: vnc_shell
description: Run a script on the remote Windows machine. Requires the vnc-helper agent. shell=powershell (default) uses a persistent PowerShell process per session name: variables, location, and modules persist across calls, with no cmd.exe quoting. shell=cmd is stateless cmd.exe /c. A busy session fails fast with session_busy (holder, script preview) unless wait_ms allows queuing; vnc_shell_state shows holders. Interactive prompts fail (-NonInteractive). Returns output (stdout+stderr in order), exit_code ($LASTEXITCODE of the last native command, sticky per session, null until one has run), elapsed_ms, timed_out (process killed; respawns next call), session_restarted (previous session had died; its state is gone).

script.description: passed verbatim to PowerShell; multi-line OK

session.description: default "default"; different names run concurrently without blocking

wait_ms.description: max wait for a busy session; default 0 (fail fast)

endpoint.description: Endpoint ID; default endpoint if omitted

name: vnc_shell_state
description: List the agent's persistent PowerShell sessions: name, pid, uptime_ms, exec_count, cwd; busy ones also show holder (client ip:port), held_ms, and a script preview. Never blocks. Use it to find who holds a busy vnc_shell session.

endpoint.description: Endpoint ID; default endpoint if omitted

name: vnc_browser_eval
description: Evaluate JavaScript via Marionette in the Firefox/Bloom browser the user is running on the target (real profile, live tabs). context=content (default) runs in the current tab; chrome gives privileged JS (Services, ChromeUtils, gBrowser). Returns data.error (Marionette error or null) and data.value (WebDriver envelope; your return value is at value.value). Requires the browser's remote agent (-marionette or marionette.enabled, port 2828). Prefer over coordinate clicks for web content. DANE cert-verify testing needs an interactively launched browser; it does not fire under Marionette.

script.description: top-level return value is serialized back as JSON

endpoint.description: Endpoint ID; default endpoint if omitted

name: vnc_browser_navigate
description: Load a URL in the current tab of the target's running Firefox/Bloom browser; vnc_browser_find handles go stale. Returns final url/title, session_established (true: shared session was (re)created, so any prior handles are stale), and elapsed_ms. Requires the browser's remote agent (-marionette, port 2828) and WinMCP >= 0.7.0 on the target.

endpoint.description: Endpoint ID; default endpoint if omitted

name: vnc_browser_find
description: Find element(s) in the current page of the target's browser. Returns element handles for vnc_browser_click/type/text/screenshot. Handles go stale on navigation, session re-establish (browser restart, >60 min idle, vnc_browser_reset, reconnect), or DOM removal; then use errors 'stale element reference' and you must re-run this. Single mode errors 'no such element' on no match; all=true returns an array (possibly empty, max 64).

value.description: CSS selector, XPath, element id, or tag name per using

endpoint.description: Endpoint ID; default endpoint if omitted

name: vnc_browser_click
description: Trusted in-DOM click on an element handle from vnc_browser_find. Prefer over vnc_click for web content; use vnc_click only for browser chrome UI Marionette cannot see. On 'stale element reference', re-run vnc_browser_find.

endpoint.description: Endpoint ID; default endpoint if omitted

name: vnc_browser_type
description: Focus an element (input, textarea, contenteditable) by vnc_browser_find handle and type plain text. No special keys; use vnc_browser_eval or vnc_key_press for Enter, Tab, or shortcuts. On 'stale element reference', re-run vnc_browser_find.

endpoint.description: Endpoint ID; default endpoint if omitted

name: vnc_browser_text
description: Read an element's rendered text by vnc_browser_find handle. For a form field's value use vnc_browser_eval. On 'stale element reference', re-run vnc_browser_find.

endpoint.description: Endpoint ID; default endpoint if omitted

name: vnc_browser_screenshot
description: PNG screenshot of the target browser's viewport, or of one element if a vnc_browser_find handle is given. Observation only. For the full desktop use vnc_screenshot. On 'stale element reference', re-run vnc_browser_find.

endpoint.description: Endpoint ID; default endpoint if omitted

name: vnc_browser_reset
description: Tear down the shared Marionette session (all element handles die); the next browser op starts a fresh one. Use when the session is wedged. Does not affect vnc_browser_eval.

endpoint.description: Endpoint ID; default endpoint if omitted

name: vnc_browser_state
description: Shared Marionette session diagnostics: alive, port, context, age/idle times, command count, current tab URL/title. A dead browser makes the call tear the session down and report alive=false. Sessions start lazily and are reaped after 60 min idle.

endpoint.description: Endpoint ID; default endpoint if omitted

name: vnc_screen_info
description: Get monitor layout, resolution, and DPI. Requires the vnc-helper agent.

endpoint.description: Endpoint ID; default endpoint if omitted

name: vnc_upload_file
description: Copy a local file to the remote Windows machine (max 10MB). Requires the vnc-helper agent.

local_path.description: absolute path on the MCP server host

endpoint.description: Endpoint ID; default endpoint if omitted

name: vnc_download_file
description: Copy a file from the remote Windows machine to a local path (max 10MB). Requires the vnc-helper agent.

local_path.description: absolute path on the MCP server host

endpoint.description: Endpoint ID; default endpoint if omitted

name: vnc_ocr_region
description: OCR the text in a screen rectangle (Windows.Media.Ocr, Win10/11). Requires the vnc-helper agent.

endpoint.description: Endpoint ID; default endpoint if omitted

name: vnc_clipboard_get
description: Return the latest clipboard text the VNC server sent (ServerCutText, sent when the remote user copies), or a note if none has arrived.

endpoint.description: Endpoint ID; default endpoint if omitted

name: vnc_helper_clipboard_get
description: Read the Windows clipboard directly, with full Unicode (unlike vnc_clipboard_get). Requires the vnc-helper agent.

endpoint.description: Endpoint ID; default endpoint if omitted

name: vnc_helper_clipboard_set
description: Set the Windows clipboard directly, with full Unicode (unlike Latin-1 vnc_clipboard_set). Paste with vnc_key_press ctrl+v. Requires the vnc-helper agent.

endpoint.description: Endpoint ID; default endpoint if omitted

name: vnc_ui_tree
description: Get the accessibility tree of the foreground window (or a process): names, control types, automation IDs, positions, sizes. More reliable than screenshots for finding controls. Requires the vnc-helper agent.

endpoint.description: Endpoint ID; default endpoint if omitted

name: vnc_ui_element_text
description: Read the text/value of a UI element found by name or automation ID (text boxes, labels, combo boxes, ...). More reliable than OCR. If several match and no index is given, returns the match count and candidates with bounding rects and text null; retry with index. Requires the vnc-helper agent.

endpoint.description: Endpoint ID; default endpoint if omitted

automation_id.description: exact match; more reliable than name

control_type.description: e.g. Button, Edit, Text, ComboBox, CheckBox, RadioButton, ListItem, TreeItem, MenuItem, Window

name: vnc_ui_click_element
description: Invoke the default action (click, toggle, select, expand) of a UI element found by name or automation ID. Fails closed: if several match and no index is given, nothing is activated and candidates with bounding rects are returned; retry with index or vnc_click a rect's center. Requires the vnc-helper agent.

endpoint.description: Endpoint ID; default endpoint if omitted

automation_id.description: exact match; more reliable than name

control_type.description: e.g. Button, CheckBox, RadioButton, MenuItem, ListItem, TreeItem

name: vnc_registry_read
description: Read a Windows registry value; returns its data and type. Requires the vnc-helper agent.

key.description: e.g. "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft"; roots HKLM, HKCU, HKCR, HKU, HKCC

endpoint.description: Endpoint ID; default endpoint if omitted

name: vnc_registry_write
description: Write a Windows registry value, creating the key if needed. Requires the vnc-helper agent.

key.description: e.g. "HKCU\SOFTWARE\MyApp"; roots HKLM, HKCU, HKCR, HKU, HKCC

endpoint.description: Endpoint ID; default endpoint if omitted

name: vnc_registry_list
description: List subkeys and values (name, type, size) under a Windows registry key. Requires the vnc-helper agent.

key.description: e.g. "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft"; roots HKLM, HKCU, HKCR, HKU, HKCC

endpoint.description: Endpoint ID; default endpoint if omitted

name: vnc_list_processes
description: List processes: name, PID, parent PID, thread count. Requires the vnc-helper agent.

endpoint.description: Endpoint ID; default endpoint if omitted

name: vnc_kill_process
description: Terminate a process by PID or executable name (name alone kills the first match). Requires the vnc-helper agent.

endpoint.description: Endpoint ID; default endpoint if omitted

name: vnc_list_services
description: List Windows services: name, display name, status. Requires the vnc-helper agent.

endpoint.description: Endpoint ID; default endpoint if omitted

name: vnc_service_control
description: Start, stop, or restart a Windows service. Requires the vnc-helper agent.

endpoint.description: Endpoint ID; default endpoint if omitted

name: vnc_calibrate
description: Measure and save the transform from coordinates in returned images to framebuffer pixels. Needed once per (client, endpoint, resolution); valid until the resolution changes. Flow: action=start returns an image with numbered markers; action=submit with samples giving each marker's magenta-dot position in the image as displayed to you (if RMSE > 4px a refine round adds markers automatically; submit those too); action=commit saves. status shows the record; clear deletes it. Afterwards pass coordinate_space=calibrated to vnc_click/vnc_drag/vnc_move_mouse/vnc_scroll/vnc_probe with positions read directly from returned images.

x.description: dot X in the image as displayed to you

y.description: dot Y in the image as displayed to you

endpoint.description: Endpoint ID; default endpoint if omitted
